title: Adoption eligibility disagrees with prompt selection
description:
The resolver’s eligibility checks are narrower than `SystemPromptParser`’s matching. Verified against the actual parser and fixture:
- `Brownfield-Adoption` selects the brownfield prompt but bypasses the resolver, so required Adoption Facts are missing.
- `concept-phase-0` selects the concept prompt but bypasses brownfield detection and adoption resumption.

Use consistent instruction normalization across selection and rendering, with regression tests for both inputs.

title: Adoption failures can be reported as successful builds
description: `renderFacts()` can throw ordinary filesystem errors through `presentPaths()` or `recognizeCi()`. For example, a `.github/workflows` path that is a file causes `ENOTDIR`. `ContextIntegrator` only rethrows `AdoptionError`, so this becomes an error-stub string returned as a successful CLI/MCP build, after adoption state has already been persisted. Wrap adoption-operation failures in `AdoptionError` and add a regression test verifying failure propagation.

title: Adoption fact errors become successful error-stub responses
description: `presentPaths` and `recognizeCi` can throw ordinary filesystem errors—for example, for a dangling `README.md` symlink. These escape after adoption state is persisted, but `ContextIntegrator.generateContextFromProject` only rethrows `AdoptionError`; other errors become stub context returned as success. Wrap these failures in `AdoptionError` and add a pipeline regression test verifying rejection rather than successful stub output.

title: Adoption fact failures are returned as successful builds
description: `renderFacts()` can throw ordinary filesystem errors—for example, when README.md is a broken symlink. `ContextIntegrator` only rethrows `AdoptionError`, so these failures become error-context strings, and MCP returns them without `isError`. Adoption state may already have been persisted. Wrap resolver failures in `AdoptionError` and add a regression test asserting that the build rejects.

title: Valid CRLF guides fail adoption validation
description: The new mandatory check uses `ContextProfileParser`, which searches for the literal `context_profiles:\n`. Verified against the committed brownfield fixture: LF finds the profile; converting it to CRLF does not. Consequently, valid Windows-style guides produce a misleading missing-profile error and block adoption builds. Normalize line endings and add a CRLF regression test.

title: Valid CRLF guides fail the adoption capability check
description: The new mandatory check uses `ContextProfileParser`, which searches for the literal `context_profiles:\n`. Running the actual parser against the brownfield fixture succeeds with LF but returns `{}` with CRLF. Consequently, a valid Windows checkout throws “missing brownfield-adoption profile,” blocking automatic and explicit adoption builds. Normalize line endings in the shared parser and add a CRLF regression test.
